rationale: A predeclared fixed set of eight intraday formulas, one per family, each scored once without search on regular-session hourly SIP bars read at the first completed bar (09:30, close 10:30) of the decision session, so search-power check B does not apply; checks A and C still bind. The cohort, label cube, windows, selection, gates, bootstrap, power and null-check parameters are campaign v4's, so the cached cube is reused and the lane-wide confirmation window remains unused until a finalist freezes; realized-volatility operators stay forbidden.
